---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with the highlight tool
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Page URL**
The URL of the page where the problem occurred. Note that pages with a strict Content-Security-Policy (e.g. GitHub, Google) block the html2canvas CDN, so capture issues on such pages are expected.

**Steps to reproduce**
1. Open the page '...'
2. Click the bookmarklet
3. Highlight '...'
4. See error

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Actual behavior**
What actually happened instead.

**Screenshots / video**
If applicable, add screenshots or a short recording to help explain your problem.

**Environment**
- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 120, Firefox 121]
- Tool version (shown in the popup header): [e.g. 1.1.0]

**Additional context**
Anything else relevant, e.g. whether the problem reproduces on a fresh page vs. after repeated use.
